definition.label: Pack surface material into a ball
definition.description: Remove up to amountLitres from a local disk on a fixed height surface and create one editable, grabbable solid ball at the requested room position. Smooth footprint weights bound available volume; a grid-missing or less-than-0.001-litre footprint refuses. Stored amount is the measured actual loss, never more than requested. The new sphere recipe and sphere collider have matching diameter derived from that local volume; material label and colour are copied into its measured store. Rigid mass is explicitly supplied, not inferred density. One atomic save/Undo updates the patch and creates/removes the ball; refusal before acceptance leaves neither partial removal nor a partial object. An accepted save failure preserves both live changes and requires recovery. Returns exact objectId and amountLitres. Ordinary grip, hold, launch, collision, animation and copy apply. Consumes one program creation allowance. Both geometry and quantity remain editable: resizing or deforming later does not rewrite the store. Does not start physics, move a hand/shovel, check reach, auto-catch or simulate grains. Stop cannot retract a completed edit; receipt replay cannot create a second ball. Outside temporary play, prepares and publishes its save in the background with one Undo edit. Completion confirms native application and saving. Once preparation begins, newer authored changes invalidate its candidate. Cancellation before native acceptance leaves the requested edit unapplied. After acceptance, stopping cannot retract the edit or its pending save. A save conflict preserves files, blocks further saves and requires inspection; never blindly replay it. Runtime clock and viewer movement continue. Concurrent persisted object edits enter preparation in arrival order after earlier saves drain, without copying a waiting candidate. Stopping or invalidating a waiter releases its place; target changes while waiting require a new request. In a temporary room, changes the live room and local Undo; a kept snapshot makes it durable. Other objects keep running. Returns the exact new objectId only after successful completion. Waiting does not allocate a saved object or native geometry; room capacity is checked again before preparation and acceptance. Stopping an accepted creation leaves it in the room; inspect before retrying.

definition.label: Saved object definition
definition.description: Canonical object metadata and exact authored revision, from the temporary fork when active. Position/rotation/scale are saved room-local values, not live physics, camera coordinates or the animated pose. Content counts describe stored drawings, recipe parts and recorded frames; modelHash is an exact asset reference, not proof of availability or completed loading. Saved metadata remains readable when the native instance is inactive or unavailable. Use object.presence to distinguish that condition from missing saved content. Name is bounded display text; an empty copy name retains the original full name. Reading grants no edit authority and takes no ownership. Use this revision for kind=copy; a missing source is unavailable.
